query:date_slot_category_label.object_description: one month calendar where date cells contain short category chips in Top, Mid, and End event slots
query:date_slot_category_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the visible category label in the requested date and slot
query:date_slot_category_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to the [x0, y0, x1, y1] box around the requested event chip in image pixel coordinates

query:category_slot_day_count.object_description: one month calendar where date cells contain short category chips in Top, Mid, and End event slots
query:category_slot_day_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the integer number of dates whose requested slot has the requested category label
query:category_slot_day_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to a JSON array of [x0, y0, x1, y1] boxes in image pixel coordinates around the matching event chips

query:date_filled_slot_count.object_description: one month calendar where date cells contain short category chips in Top, Mid, and End event slots
query:date_filled_slot_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the integer number of filled event slots on the requested date
query:date_filled_slot_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to a JSON array of [x0, y0, x1, y1] boxes in image pixel coordinates around the event chips on the requested date, or [] if no slots are filled
